items.title: UK and Ireland base map (OpenStreetMap)

items.title: Contours

items.title: Hillshade
items.licence: OGL v3 (OS Terrain 50, OSNI); Copernicus DEM licence (ESA)

items.title: Map sprites
items.description: Icon sprite sheets for the Protomaps and OS styles.

items.title: Map fonts

items.title: Phone map packs (Organic Maps)
items.description: Offline map files for Android phones, copied over USB from a PC. The index page at maps/packs/index.html lists the individual .mwm files and, when included, the Android app.

items.title: Organic Maps Android app
items.description: The Android app that reads the phone map packs (release 2026.08.27-18).
